scenario: count_distinct counts DISTINCT values, not raw observations (LSER.16.5.2). Asserting the same value (7) four times yields a distinct cardinality of 1 — a raw `count` would reach 4. Pin: a rule gated `count_distinct(r.val) >= 2` (the declared 5_s window, LSER.6.11.3) NEVER fires, so its `action_log` is forbidden. This proves the duplicates collapse to one distinct value; the companion positive fixture LSER.16.5.2.runtime confirms the backend is loaded and does fire on genuinely-distinct values.
rules_ds:
use default

schema Reading scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    val: Int mutable

series Reading.val:
    count_distinct sliding 5_s

rule never_fires:
    Reading r where count_distinct(r.val) >= 2
->
    log info "should not fire"
